tier_rationale: The R8 has built-in Bluetooth for its optional R/Tach companion app, but Uniden operates no cloud service the detector depends on: radar/laser detection and GPS-based red-light/speed-camera alerts run entirely on the device using its own onboard database, the app connects directly to the detector over Bluetooth with no account or sign-in, and database updates are applied locally through a USB cable and a computer, not a subscription service.
the_unplug_test: Nothing changes. The R8 detects radar and laser and issues GPS-based alerts for known red-light and speed cameras entirely on its own, using a database stored on the device. The R/Tach phone app is an optional way to change settings from your phone over a direct Bluetooth link — Uniden's own product page confirms GPS-based alerting keeps working 'requiring no pairing or smartphone connection' at all. Database and firmware updates are free and applied by connecting the detector to a computer with a USB cable and Uniden's own software; there is no subscription and no vendor server in the alerting path.

sources.supports: Manufacturer product page: 'The Uniden R8 does include built-in Bluetooth and R/Tach app connectivity'; GPS-based red-light/speed-camera alerts described as working with 'no pairing or smartphone connection' required; updates 'handled through your computer using Uniden's official software tools' with 'free updates to the radar detector firmware' — no subscription language anywhere on the page.

Official R/Tach app store listing describes the app connecting directly to the detector over Bluetooth ('Seamlessly connect to your Uniden R/TACH radar/laser detectors... and effortlessly customize and fine-tune your detector settings') with no mention of account creation, sign-in, or an online service anywhere in the listing.

FCC grant AMWUA2102, model UA2102, Uniden America Corporation, granted 2022-01-25, classified as a Part 15 Radar Detector covering 10.5-10.55GHz, 23.9-24.25GHz and 33.4-35.7GHz radar/laser detection bands. Confirms the device's core detection hardware and grantee identity; the grant does not cover a 2.4GHz Bluetooth radio, consistent with the Bluetooth module likely being certified separately or under a pre-certified module grant not surfaced by this search.

open_questions: Whether the Bluetooth radio has its own separate FCC grant (not found via grantee search for 'Uniden R8') or operates under a pre-certified module's existing grant was not resolved.
Whether the R/Tach app makes any background network calls (analytics/telemetry) once installed was not tested — phones_home left unknown rather than asserted as none.
Current US price band was not confirmed.
The related Uniden R8W (Wi-Fi variant) and R7 were not verified in this run; do not assume this record applies to those SKUs.
notes: Chosen over the R7 because Uniden's own R7 page did not clearly state whether Bluetooth is built in (no mention of Bluetooth or WiFi found on that page, only a generically-described 'R/TACH app' connection), while the R8 page explicitly confirms built-in Bluetooth. Uniden also sells an R8W with WiFi 'for wireless updates or remote control' — a genuinely different, more connected SKU under a related but distinct model number; this record covers the R8 only, not the R8W.
